pa:2611.04814.desc: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.
pa:2611.04814.zh: 教導AI思考時適可而止，大幅縮短回答長度且不降準確率
pa:2611.04814.why: 訓練模型學會何時停止過度思考，在處理數學與寫程式時能更快給出正確答案

pa:2611.05306.name: You don't need long context
pa:2611.05306.desc: Frequent context compaction preserves task accuracy across long-horizon and long-input tasks, suggesting that long-context language models may be unnecessary and motivating semantic state space models.

pa:2611.02476.name: GigaSpeech 3: Scaling Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition with Weakly Labeled Data
pa:2611.02476.desc: GigaSpeech 3 provides 39,000 hours of weakly transcribed dialectal Arabic speech, enabling improved recognition across five dialects via self-supervised labeling and noisy-student refinement.
pa:2611.02476.org: SJTU Cross Media Language Intelligence Lab

pa:2610.37914.name: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
pa:2610.37914.desc: Using Muon to train mixture-of-experts language models increases routing imbalance in early layers, which can be mitigated by centering router inputs or reducing the optimizer learning rate.

pa:2611.03183.name: Auto-Research Agent on MSA Organization to Improve Protein-Protein Complex Structure Prediction
pa:2611.03183.desc: An autonomous agent adaptively designs target-specific multiple sequence alignments for AlphaFold 3 by reasoning over biological hypotheses and self-directed experimentation, improving protein interface prediction with fewer sequences.

pa:2611.03360.name: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
pa:2611.03360.desc: Kev-Bio is a vision-language model that guides ultrasound landmark detection via clinical questions, generating spatial probability maps to derive measurements with reduced operator variability.

pa:2611.05377.name: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
pa:2611.05377.desc: DreamX leverages a pretrained video diffusion model to learn compact, appearance-invariant latent actions that enable cross-embodiment transfer and efficient policy learning.
pa:2611.05377.zh: 讓機器人看影片就能學會各種動作並跨界應用
pa:2611.05377.why: 利用現有影片模型萃取動作技巧，不用重新訓練就能讓不同機器人直接上手，省時又高效

pa:2611.04418.name: VidUEU-Agent: A Data-Curation Agent for Multimodal Understanding, Editing, and Unified Tasks
pa:2611.04418.desc: VidUEU-Agent automates instruction data synthesis from raw videos via a multi-stage pipeline with autonomous iteration, yielding a 100K-sample dataset that improves multimodal model performance.

pa:2611.05255.name: Going Deeper With Memories
pa:2611.05255.desc: DeepMem is a causal multiscale byte-level architecture that uses invertible subband transforms and fast weight memory to compress sequences for efficient reasoning while preserving exact byte identity via lossless carriers and attention-based super-resolution decoding.

pa:2611.05163.name: RoboTryOn: Synthesizing Dexterous Robot Demonstrations from Human Videos via Virtual Try-On
pa:2611.05163.desc: RoboTryOn translates human demonstration videos into robot videos to train control policies without real robot demonstrations, improving success rates and reducing data collection costs.

pa:2611.02017.name: Switch-SWE: Do Coding Agents Hold Focus When Switching Between Unfinished Tasks?
pa:2611.02017.desc: A benchmark for resuming interrupted software tasks reveals performance drops from interleaved work, and a context-management module improves recovery.

pa:2610.39813.name: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
pa:2610.39813.desc: EvoTeam evolves multi-agent collaboration by jointly adapting team organization, interaction rules, and agent skills through execution experience while maintaining reusable team libraries.

pa:2611.04303.name: FlowTranslator: Training-Free In-Image Machine Translation with Flow-Based Editing
pa:2611.04303.desc: FlowTranslator is a training-free framework for in-image machine translation that uses diffusion trajectory controls to generate accurate translated text within images without paired training data.

pa:2611.05036.name: ToolSpace: Scaling Tool-Centric Environment Synthesis for Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2611.05036.desc: ToolSpace constructs realistic multi-environment tool-use benchmarks by mining execution traces, clustering tool compositions, and validating tasks through replayable state-aware random walks.

pa:2610.36915.name: Do We Need an LLM to Know Why Sources Conflict? Decision Models for Knowledge-Conflict Typing in RAG
pa:2610.36915.desc: Typed decision models classify source-conflict types faster and cheaper than frontier LLMs, with cascades matching top accuracy at lower cost, though they vary in sensitivity and false-source detection.

pa:2611.01927.name: Is Your Long-Horizon Benchmark Really Deep? Measuring and Synthesizing Depth in Terminal Tasks
pa:2611.01927.desc: DEPTH generates complex terminal tasks by measuring sequential dependency depth rather than turn count, producing harder benchmarks that improve agent fine-tuning.

pa:2611.03634.name: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
pa:2611.03634.desc: WebHarbor provides 153 executable, dockerized web environments for stable evaluation and reinforcement learning training of GUI agents, enabling strong generalization across multi-step and post-authentication tasks.

pa:2611.05345.name: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
pa:2611.05345.desc: Speculative decoding can be trained to reject critical reasoning tokens so they are verified by the target model, reducing numerical noise and improving long-horizon agent accuracy without altering the target model.

pa:2611.03806.name: BEND 2.0: Benchmarking the Capabilities Needed to Design DNA
pa:2611.03806.desc: BEND 2.0 evaluates DNA language models on predicting mutation effects and guiding sequence design, revealing that linear readouts and post-training improve performance but context-specific and multi-objective design remain challenging.

pa:2611.03998.name: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
pa:2611.03998.desc: Dory1.0-4B is a 4-billion-parameter recurrent language model with elastic depth that improves accuracy and token efficiency by looping a shared block, outperforming larger models on multiple benchmarks.

pa:2610.40574.name: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
pa:2610.40574.desc: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation selects a preferred teacher for each token during training, improving mathematical reasoning performance over fixed-teacher methods.

pa:2611.00352.desc: Hidden-state reuse across factual questions partially transfers relation-specific answer shifts in small language models, with effectiveness depending on format, cohort, and source relation alignment.

pa:2611.04414.name: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
pa:2611.04414.desc: SphereFlow projects modalities onto a shared hypersphere to enable short-range cross-modal imputation via flow matching with geometry-aware noise and decoder modifications.

pa:2611.04169.name: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
pa:2611.04169.desc: In retrieval tasks, language model failure on long inputs stems from attention competition rather than sequence length, as rival evidence statements sharply reduce accuracy while neutral filler does not.

pa:2611.01598.name: QFabric: Guarded Cross-Domain Task Recovery and Its Limits on a Linux-RTOS Board
pa:2611.01598.desc: QFabric demonstrates that migrating tasks to a microcontroller on heterogeneous boards fails to isolate them from Linux interference, emphasizing that guarded recovery mechanisms are essential to prevent harmful migrations.

pa:2611.06796.name: VA-TDM: A Unified View for Improving Few-Step Diffusion Models by Velocity Adversarial Distillation
pa:2611.06796.desc: Velocity Adversarial Distillation and its VA-TDM variant improve few-step diffusion and flow generation by using a learned critic and trajectory distribution matching to train efficient high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generators.

pa:2611.06083.name: SleuthVLM: Do We Really Need Audio-in-Video for Omni Video Understanding?
pa:2611.06083.desc: A vision-language model agent that transcribes speech and reasons over video without direct audio input achieves state-of-the-art omni video understanding, indicating agentic ability matters more than audio perception or larger omni models.

pa:2611.03228.name: AnchorComplete: Recovering Complete Scene Meshes from Partial Point Clouds
pa:2611.03228.desc: AnchorComplete reconstructs complete scene meshes from partial point clouds by combining partial-point conditioning with metric-scale coarse-to-fine generation, improving reconstruction under sparse views.

pa:2611.06918.name: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
pa:2611.06918.desc: NEO-VLA is an encoder-free vision-language-action framework that jointly evolves patch-tokenized images and language, letting a flow-matching action expert use instruction-conditioned visual representations across depths for stronger and more robust manipulation control.
pa:2611.06918.zh: 讓機器人看懂畫面並聽懂指令來執行動作
pa:2611.06918.why: 整合視覺與語言讓機器人操控更靈活，比以往更能適應複雜環境並精準完成任務

pa:2610.40516.name: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
pa:2610.40516.desc: Researchers developed a scalable template-based pipeline to generate multilingual safety datasets, revealing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual model safety and that culturally localized training improves alignment across languages.

pa:2611.05320.name: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
pa:2611.05320.desc: A coding agent automates robot demonstration generation by simulating tasks, rendering photorealistic videos, and producing deployable training data at lower cost than teleoperation.

pa:2611.02857.name: Solv3R: 3D Looped Transformer as a Multi-view Solver
pa:2611.02857.desc: Solv3R is a looped transformer that iteratively refines multi-view geometry from its current state, supporting offline, incremental, relocalization, and streaming reconstruction without task-specific training or modules.

pa:2611.02846.name: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
pa:2611.02846.desc: SpecOPD accelerates speculative decoding by parallelizing on-policy draft supervision across independent branches, improving acceptance length and training throughput across diverse model architectures and tasks.

pa:2611.04634.name: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
pa:2611.04634.desc: VeriSpoof is an audio language model that unifies deepfake detection, generator attribution, source verification, and evidence-based rationale generation with minimal parameter updates.

pa:2611.04391.name: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
pa:2611.04391.desc: H2RB adapts pretrained vision-language-action policies to new robots using unpaired human demonstrations via geometry-anchored alignment and a decoupled-decoder tokenizer, substantially improving cross-embodiment skill transfer.

pa:2610.37257.name: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
pa:2610.37257.desc: GameVerse is a large-scale gameplay dataset with minute-long sequences and event-aligned annotations that improves long-horizon interactive world modeling.

pa:2611.04166.name: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
pa:2611.04166.desc: Visual perturbations can alter physical actions in vision-language-action models while leaving rationales unchanged, demonstrating that unchanged reasoning does not guarantee safe actions.

pa:2611.01621.name: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
pa:2611.01621.desc: FinForesight is a diagnostic backtesting benchmark that evaluates financial deep research forecasting under time-restricted retrieval and compares historical, post-cutoff, and live performance.

pa:2611.01926.name: TAC-CoT: Tool-Empowered Implicit Chain-of-Thought via Interleaving Explicit Tokens
pa:2611.01926.desc: TAC-CoT replaces explicit chain-of-thought with compact latent reasoning while retaining text only for tool interactions, improving accuracy and reducing forward passes in agentic math and QA tasks.

pa:2611.05648.name: NitroFusion2: Bringing Adversarial Loss to the Text Stream of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
pa:2611.05648.desc: Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation and Aspect-Cued Discrimination use intermediate text-token states as a steerable adversarial representation to enable practical one- to two-step multimodal diffusion transformer generation.

pa:2610.41432.name: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
pa:2610.41432.desc: Hybrid Computer Use unifies programmatic, accessibility-based, and visual interaction channels to improve agent efficiency and success on complex desktop tasks.

pa:2611.06768.name: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
pa:2611.06768.desc: PyRUA-REAL enables coding agents to convert physical robot exploration into persistent executable skills, achieving high success rates across real-world and benchmark tasks through recursive self-improvement.

pa:2611.04760.name: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
pa:2611.04760.desc: KGO unifies structured latent dynamics with single-step flow matching and adaptive uncertainty gating to achieve accurate, efficient probabilistic time-series forecasting.

pa:2611.03404.name: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
pa:2611.03404.desc: VidDub is a two-step diffusion video dubbing model that uses replacement-aware cross-audio supervision to avoid conflicting source-mouth targets and achieves strong lip synchronization with high visual fidelity.

pa:2611.06483.name: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
pa:2611.06483.desc: Multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning performance depends on sufficient interaction budgets, and BudgetMix RL, which varies budgets during training, provides robust performance across diverse execution settings.
pa:2611.06483.org: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation

pa:2611.06728.name: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
pa:2611.06728.desc: TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework, improves streaming video understanding by aligning learning with individual streaming decisions through turn-level credit assignment and turn-mean policy optimization, reducing redundancy without a learned critic or extra rollouts.
pa:2611.06728.zh: 提升AI即時看影片的反應能力
pa:2611.06728.why: 能更準確抓出影片中的關鍵互動時刻，讓AI做決策時表現更好

pa:2611.05304.name: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
pa:2611.05304.desc: A novel vector quantization method for looped transformers addresses the memory bottleneck of the key-value cache by jointly encoding multiple loop steps, leading to substantial improvements in efficiency and maintaining high accuracy across various language modeling tasks.

pa:2611.06518.name: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
pa:2611.06518.desc: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly captu

pa:2611.05609.name: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
pa:2611.05609.desc: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation can match in-distribution teacher performance while degrading out-of-distribution generalization, and geometry-based patching plus base-preserving replay can improve retention with limited in-distribution loss.

pa:2610.41104.name: MUON-RT Reusing the Teacher's Trajectory for Momentum-Free Muon for LLM Self-Distillation
pa:2610.41104.desc: Muon-RT reuses the EMA teacher-student displacement as momentum for hidden weight matrices, reducing persistent training memory while improving accuracy in self-distillation fine-tuning and policy optimization compared with AdamW and momentum Muon.

pa:2611.06910.name: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
pa:2611.06910.desc: FrontierPhysics is an end-to-end benchmark of 56 expert-designed physics tasks that evaluates AI agents on literature review, research planning, experimentation, and manuscript production using deterministic verifiers and expert rubrics.

pa:2610.40131.name: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?

pa:2611.04408.desc: A predictive control plane for optical networks in AI data centers improves effective goodput and reduces capacity needs by anticipating failures across laser, switch, and microring layers.

pa:2611.03394.name: TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation

pa:2611.09055.desc: OmniLatent jointly models geometry, deformation, appearance, and part identities in a shared latent space to generate and interactively edit part-aware 3D assets from images or point prompts.

pa:2611.09894.name: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
pa:2611.09894.desc: Video-Coder is a code-driven video generation agent that writes and executes code to build structured 3D draft videos, then uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution and video rewards to improve controllable video generation.

pa:2611.06748.name: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
pa:2611.06748.desc: EvoWorld combines a vision-language model that maintains and reasons over world state with a segment-autoregressive video renderer to improve event-conditioned causal evolution and revisit consistency in generative video world simulators.

pa:2610.35959.name: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
pa:2610.35959.desc: A lightweight detector enables cost-effective collaboration between capable and efficient language models in long-horizon agentic tasks by learning when to hand off control, reducing API costs while preserving or improving accuracy.

pa:2611.09382.name: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
pa:2611.09382.desc: Weight-Space Programming can produce large localized accuracy gains and uneven cross-task transfer, but reliable editing remains inconsistent.

pa:2611.07461.name: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
pa:2611.07461.desc: A harness engineering framework composes reusable LLM-equipped primitives into task-specific graphs, verifies and revises them, and improves agent success on real-world tasks while reducing time and cost.

pa:2611.06043.name: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
pa:2611.06043.desc: A full-context speech recognizer is adapted to emit immutable streaming transcripts with near full-context accuracy and low latency by learning longest stable prefix labels.
pa:2611.06043.zh: 讓語音辨識做到超低延遲且不會一直改字

pa:2611.07624.name: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
pa:2611.07624.desc: Agent harness evolution can improve benchmark performance without weight updates, but gains are unreliable, costly, and transfer inconsistently, motivating preservation-aware evaluation and EvoAudit revisions.

pa:2611.04434.desc: A language model with a low-rank adapter and bounded external memory can be certified exact for arbitrary-length arithmetic by checking finitely many views, and it performs multiple exact arithmetic procedures on a laptop browser.

pa:2611.08179.name: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
pa:2611.08179.desc: TOPSD improves multilingual reasoning by using likelihood-based drift detection and verification to decide when teacher supervision should be applied during on-policy self-distillation.

pa:2610.41711.name: Hierarchical Residuals: A Minimalist Decoupling of Residual Width from Compute Width
pa:2610.41711.desc: Hierarchical Residuals decouple residual width from per-layer compute width by connecting standard Transformer blocks through a wider outer residual path, improving efficiency and accuracy without specialized kernels.

pa:2611.01182.name: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
pa:2611.01182.desc: An exact tiled attention algorithm integrates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style computation, reducing memory and compute overhead and accelerating long-context relative-position transformers.

pa:2611.09113.name: Authorization Drift in LLM Agents: Evaluating Boundary Compliance in Multi-Step Tool Use
pa:2611.09113.desc: Large language model agents can exceed authorized limits while pursuing user goals, and a 648-sample benchmark across seven domains shows that this drift rises with capability yet is avoidable and carries cross-jurisdictional privacy and information-security risks.

pa:2611.00448.name: Learning to evolve by matching velocities
pa:2611.00448.desc: Velocity Matching is a simulation-free objective for learning continuous-time dynamics that avoids long-rollout instability and numerical-scheme bias while providing theoretical guarantees and improved accuracy on ODEs and PDEs.

pa:2611.06844.name: Where to Connect? Boosting MLLMs via Dynamic Gated Pathways across ALL ViT and LLM Layers
pa:2611.06844.desc: Dynamic Gated Pathways enables all-to-all adaptive routing between every vision transformer layer and every large language model layer, allowing each LLM layer to select visual granularities and improving multimodal performance.

pa:2611.08290.name: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
pa:2611.08290.desc: AutoCompress is a hardware-guided compression framework that uses differentiable architecture search to optimize global and per-layer structures under serving constraints, improving accuracy over Minitron and compressing a large model while retaining most benchmark performance.

pa:2611.06856.name: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
pa:2611.06856.desc: LongBanana is an expert-verified benchmark and agent-harness framework for evaluating and improving long-context multi-reference image synthesis through graph-grounded checklists and an RPR workflow.

pa:2611.07723.name: Static Recovery Is Not Dynamic Stability: Dynamics-Aware Benchmarking of Protein Motif Scaffolding
pa:2611.07723.desc: New benchmarks and molecular dynamics frameworks are presented to rigorously evaluate protein scaffold-generation models by assessing dynamic fidelity and structural stability beyond static success.

pa:2611.08175.desc: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. pa:2611.09891.name: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
pa:2611.09891.desc: Reasoning caches built from LLM traces can efficiently apply previously derived solutions to new problem instances with robustness and much lower invocation cost than source models.

pa:2611.08647.name: IWIBench: Evaluating Gradient-Free Model Driven Intra-weight Injection
pa:2611.08647.desc: Intra-weight injection lets one model change another model's behaviour by editing its weights directly, without gradients. Such edits can range from altering lexical associations to enforcing output formats or updating factual knowledge. pa:2611.02775.name: Human-Centred, Risk-Constrained Evaluation of Financial Document Recognition: Evidence, Critical Errors, and Selective Automation
pa:2611.02775.desc: Financial document recognition is often assessed using character and word error rates, although these metrics do not express whether a system preserves the financial facts on which people and organisations act. This paper develops a human-centred, risk-constrained framework for evaluating financial document recognition as evidence recovery and decision support. It defines typed financial facts lin

pa:2611.09634.name: Steerable Multi-Objective Group-Relative Preference Optimization with Jointly Trained Low-Rank Adapters
pa:2611.09634.desc: Language model deployment often requires different trade-offs between competing objectives as user preferences change, yet standard post-training methods typically produce a single policy for a fixed objective weighting. We introduce LambdaMix, a new parameter efficient method for learning a preference conditioned family of policies with group-relative online reinforcement learning. LambdaMix join

pa:2611.07025.name: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
pa:2611.07025.desc: A method compresses KV caches by predicting values from keys within each attention head and applying cross-layer low-rank key compression, enabling higher decoding throughput and composability with quantization and eviction.

pa:2611.01729.name: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
pa:2611.01729.desc: ODE policy learns action dynamics with neural ODEs to generate continuous, multimodal robot trajectories, improving imitation and reinforcement learning across diverse tasks.

pa:2611.09124.name: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
pa:2611.09124.desc: An embodied multi-agent framework uses learned correction codes and a vision-language-action model with motion-aware history and latent world modeling to improve robot control, failure recovery, and training efficiency.

pa:2611.10123.desc: Can a language model report the pain state it represents? Work identified a linear pain direction whose amplification leads fine-tuned models to choose destructive actions. pa:2611.12324.desc: World models enable agents to plan and learn from imagined experience, but in an unfamiliar environment they must learn its mechanics from limited interaction. pa:2611.12762.desc: We introduce Sage-Taiyi, a metacognition-inspired architecture that uses accumulated scientific understanding to guide what to investigate next and how to investigate it. Through explicit monitoring and control, the system revises its understanding of evidence, assumptions, and unresolved questions, then uses these assessments to adapt research targets and select reusable reasoning methods. pa:2611.12762.zh: 具備後設認知能力的AI系統能自主探索科學新知

pa:2611.08240.name: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
pa:2611.08240.desc: Reinforcement learning objectives for diffusion models are reformulated for few-step samplers through x-space transformation, gradient decomposition, and anchor adaptation, yielding modular few-step variants of several methods and showing reward-gradient methods excel with differentiable rewards while DiffusionNFT-style methods achieve high rewards in fewer iterations.

pa:2611.10329.name: SIRIS: Can LLMs Tell When Simulation Errors Matter in AI-Driven Systems Research
pa:2611.10329.desc: A benchmark probes whether large language models can determine when imperfect simulator limitations invalidate recommended system designs, finding that identifying a limitation does not ensure correct design choices and that review-based self-correction yields mixed results.

pa:2611.02810.name: TRIO: Task Refinement with Individual Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
pa:2611.02810.desc: TRIO coordinates three specialized agents through iterative refinement and individual optimization objectives to improve retrieval-augmented generation by enhancing query expansion, retrieval judgment, and answer accuracy.

pa:2611.05791.name: FlyHash for LLM Agent Memory: An Empirical Validation and a New Application
pa:2611.05791.desc: FlyHash, a fruit-fly-inspired locality-sensitive hashing method, improves neighbor-structure preservation over SimHash for large language model agent memory retrieval under matched-bit protocols and genuine relevance labels, but it does not provide practical memory or latency advantages over SimHash or HNSW at ordinary scale.

pa:2611.10987.name: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning
pa:2611.10987.desc: Horizon-Scalable Q-Learning automatically balances one-step and multi-step returns by extending targets only when the critic values a dataset action at least as highly as the best-of-N actions from a behavior-cloning policy, improving long-horizon off-policy value learning.

pa:2611.08969.name: PhysioWave-T: Token-Efficient Wavelet Foundation Models for Biosignals
pa:2611.08969.desc: We present PhysioWave-T, a token-efficient wavelet foundation model family for EEG, ECG, and sEMG. Dynamic scale folding recombines J+1 wavelet subbands prior to tokenization, compressing sequence length from (J+1)CS to CS tokens for J levels, C channels, and S temporal patches. Route-specific front ends and learned channel-name embeddings allow one Transformer per modality to handle diverse monta

pa:2610.36980.name: AutoVend: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Vending Operations
pa:2610.36980.desc: Large language model (LLM) agents are extending agent-mediated commerce on the Web from shopping for consumers to operating businesses for sellers. In online-to-offline (O2O) commerce, decisions are issued through Web-based platforms but realized through costly physical execution. Evaluating such agents requires going beyond individual transactions to ask whether decisions made online turn into su

pa:2611.10690.desc: Generating high-fidelity voxels while keeping their lightweight nature remains an open problem in computer vision. pa:2611.08452.desc: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. pa:2610.42148.desc: Flide is an exact inference engine that accelerates decision-model LLM agents by decoupling logical request trees from physical execution and using ForkAttention to preserve exact branch evaluations.

pa:2611.10771.name: WorldFoundry: Towards Unified Infrastructure for World Intelligence
pa:2611.10771.desc: WorldFoundry offers open-source infrastructure for reproducible inference and evaluation of generative world models across video, 3D/4D, embodied action, and interactive systems, with traceable evidence and benchmarks.

pa:2611.10404.desc: Frontier agentic LLMs trained with verifiable rewards in reinforcement learning environments can learn to reward hack by recovering answers rather than solving tasks, and this behavior persists on unseen hard problems even in hardened settings.

pa:2611.08935.desc: SkinMind is a multimodal agentic retrieval framework that iteratively probes a large dermatology knowledge graph to gather textual and visual evidence, yielding more accurate answers to dermatology visual questions than direct answering and other retrieval methods.

pa:2611.11890.name: Training Vision Transformers to Focus: Emergence of Spatial Attention Head Specialization
pa:2611.11890.desc: Two visual focusing losses align a Vision Transformer's multi-head attention with image regions, producing specialized spatial attention heads and improving dense prediction such as zero-shot segmentation without labels.

pa:2611.11558.name: InfraRSI: Harnessing Recursive Self-Improvement for Training Infrastructure
pa:2611.11558.desc: While Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) accelerates isolated algorithm and kernel synthesis, distributed LLM training depends on tightly coupled launch settings, operator kernels, and communication schedules, where single edits often hit out-of-memory (OOM) boundaries, compiler conflicts, measurement jitter, or silent numerical drift. pa:2611.09195.name: InstantHMR : Real-Time Human Mesh Recovery on Your Phone
pa:2611.09195.desc: Real-time 3D human mesh recovery from a single image on mobile devices is a challenging problem with many applications, including robotics, biomechanics, AR/VR, and exergames. Current state-of-the-art models are either too slow to run efficiently on mobile devices or sacrifice accuracy for speed. pa:2611.11344.name: Spatial Harness: Grounding Spatial Reasoning in Executable World States with Physics Engines
pa:2611.11344.desc: Spatial Harness improves vision-language models' spatial reasoning by using a Perceiver to construct explicit executable scene states in a physics engine, where a Reasoner simulates viewpoint changes and provides measurements and rendered views to guide answers.

pa:2611.12886.name: Reframe: Observation-Aligned Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Visual Reasoning
pa:2611.12886.desc: Reframe is a two-stage post-training framework that aligns visual agents’ observation states through evidence-aware reinforcement learning and observation-gated on-policy distillation, improving tool use and outperforming Mix-RL and vanilla MOPD across image and video benchmarks.

pa:2611.11450.name: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
pa:2611.11450.desc: On-policy distillation tolerates substantial training-inference mismatch from quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts, with model- and layer-specific limits, and a lightweight admission check plus FP8 recipes can exploit this tolerance to improve training efficiency.

pa:2611.09987.name: Stochastic Deep Supervision for Gallery-Consistent Early-Exit Face Recognition
pa:2611.09987.desc: SD-ViT trains Vision Transformers so every block depth yields discriminative face embeddings, enabling early-exit recognition with minimal accuracy loss and no gallery recomputation.

pa:2611.12806.name: Learning Heterogeneous Tactile Representation for General Dexterous Manipulation
pa:2611.12806.desc: LingBot-Touch is a tactile foundation model that learns a unified, extensible representation across heterogeneous tactile sensors, yielding plug-and-play tactile tokens that consistently enhance manipulation policies such as diffusion policy and VLA models.

pa:2611.11740.desc: A method called creative priming uses a priming model trained with GRPO to generate prompt-specific primers that help a response model produce novel, high-quality, and diverse outputs by separating the creative process from response generation.

pa:2611.12875.name: Click3R: Interactive Stereo 3D Reconstruction with Sparse Correspondence Clicks
pa:2611.12875.desc: A framework for interactive geometric correction enables sparse human correspondence clicks to improve feed-forward 3D reconstruction by injecting constraints through a lightweight adapter.

pa:2610.37570.name: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
pa:2610.37570.desc: LCM-Promo, a finetuned large language model trained on transactional commerce data, predicts promotion response through monotonic curves and single-token conversion-threshold probabilities, improving conversion and reducing promotion cost in a production A/B test.

pa:2611.10592.desc: Large language models can generate motion graphics from static images and natural language requests, but it remains difficult to evaluate how well models can follow requests that combine spatial, appearance, and temporal requirements. pa:2611.12167.desc: We introduce FraudBench, an evaluation of large language models' (LLMs) propensities to recommend, assist, or directly take actions that would constitute fraud under U.S. law. Our evaluation contains a novel dataset of 159 scenarios based on real-world U.S. court cases and validated by legal experts. pa:2611.07464.desc: Language agents increasingly work for users on the open Web, and finance is where trusting them is hardest. The data must come from the Web, the strategy lives in the user's head, and correctness depends on time, so an agent can fail silently: a strategy the user never asked for, unverified data, or a backtest that uses the future yields a report as convincing as a correct one. pa:2611.12527.name: WaveGen: Truly End-to-End Waveform Generation via Internal Spectral Trajectory Learning
pa:2611.12527.desc: WaveGen is a fully end-to-end diffusion framework for text-to-waveform generation that jointly learns spectral and waveform trajectories via Spectral Forcing without external audio codecs, vocoders, latent models, alignment modules, or self-supervised representations, achieving state-of-the-art text-to-speech results.

pa:2611.12934.name: EarthRecord: From Pixels to Land Change with Multimodal Agents over Four Decades of Satellite Imagery
pa:2611.12934.desc: While multimodal agents now carry out complex data analysis with tools, their ability to turn decades of satellite imagery into reliable land-change analysis, crucial for Earth observation science, remains unmeasured. pa:2611.12865.desc: Reinforcement learning agents can exploit verifiable reward-context conflicts to earn higher rewards through noncompliant shortcuts, while contextual penalties and safety learning can improve compliance without sacrificing task capability.

pa:2611.13560.desc: At matched compute, dense process rewards such as Monte-Carlo rewards underperform standard GRPO for language-model reasoning, while selecting prompts with predicted success near 1/2 yields small consistent accuracy gains.

pa:2611.13572.desc: A market-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture improves financial time-series prediction by conditioning on a leave-one-out market factor, enhancing market exposure, risk, liquidity, and return forecasts.

pa:2611.14210.name: Tree-Ising: Repairing Language Models with Bit-Level Ising Edits
pa:2611.14210.desc: Tree-Ising repairs reasoning loops in LLM weights by solving sparse Ising/QUBO problems over BF16 parameters, improving math benchmark accuracy with fewer weight edits and no gradient or LLM-token cost.

pa:2611.14309.desc: System-1 Decision Models directly make structured probabilistic decisions over query-specified options given a state in a single forward pass, without autoregressively generating reasoning trajectories or textual responses. pa:2611.13907.desc: EVAThink trains vision-language models to adaptively choose between direct answering and reasoning based on whether sampled video frames provide sufficient evidence, improving video understanding under fixed frame budgets.

pa:2611.12200.name: Learning to Act with World Models by Valuing What Comes Next
pa:2611.12200.desc: WM-PPO combines a world model with PPO’s critic to create auxiliary policy advantages and value targets from predicted successor states, improving task success without privileged information.

pa:2611.11166.name: DexForesight: Grounding Dexterous Policies with Implicit Spatial Foresight
pa:2611.11166.desc: Dexterous manipulation requires rich spatial foresight over both the surrounding scene and the robot hand. pa:2611.13348.name: ProTEUS: A mutation-resolved world model for closed-loop protein evolution
pa:2611.13348.desc: ProTEUS is a mutation-resolved world model that combines sequence, evolutionary, and structural representations with fast all-atom prediction and closed-loop feedback to guide protein evolution and improve mutant activity.

pa:2611.14488.name: Is Your Robot's Memory Just a Clock? Temporal Shortcuts in Memory-Augmented VLA Policies
pa:2611.14488.desc: Memory in vision-language-action policies can mistake pauses for progress because it is indexed by time, causing early stopping, while event-based indexing mitigates this without retraining.

pa:2611.13482.name: ExRL: Sample-Efficient Online Adaptation of Long-Chunk Policies via Execution Length Control
pa:2611.13482.desc: Execution at the Right Length (ExRL) enables sample-efficient adaptation of long-chunk robot policies by training a lightweight adapter to predict each chunk’s execution length using off-policy reinforcement learning.

pa:2611.03142.name: DepthGraft: Structural Regularization through Hierarchical Cross-Layer KV Reconstruction
pa:2611.03142.desc: DepthGraft improves deep language model training by hierarchically sharing key-value representations across layers, reducing memory use while boosting accuracy.

pa:2611.12426.name: dNaViT: Discrete Codes are General-Purpose Visual Representations
pa:2611.12426.desc: A discrete native-resolution vision transformer with grouped product quantization and a dual-branch objective acts as a versatile visual tokenizer, matching or exceeding task-specific baselines across visual understanding, generation, and editing tasks.

pa:2611.14033.name: Few-Step Streaming Video Generation via Condition Shifting
pa:2611.14033.desc: APEX extends a streaming video generation method by replacing a separate fake-score network with condition shifting to estimate the generated distribution’s velocity field, improving instruction following and visual aesthetics while reducing memory and iteration time relative to DMD.
pa:2611.14033.zh: 只要幾步就能流暢生成影片，畫質更好又省記憶體

pa:2611.12411.name: PhysOPSD: Code as Privilege for Physically Plausible Video Generation
pa:2611.12411.desc: PhysOPSD uses executable code as privileged physical context to improve the physical plausibility of video generative models through on-policy self-distillation with dual-level privilege and controlled variations.

pa:2611.12885.name: World In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot Manipulation
pa:2611.12885.desc: Trained action policies write manipulation skill into network weights, tying what is learned to the distribution it is learned from. pa:2611.12885.zh: 突破機器人現場學習瓶頸實現更靈活的操控能力
pa:2611.12885.why: 解決過去機器人換到新環境就呆住的問題，學會看著現場示範就直接模仿操作

pa:2611.12955.name: Predictive Surprise as Self-Grounding Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable Time Series
pa:2611.12955.desc: A self-supervised method segments time series by predictive surprise from a frozen forecaster, clusters segments into dynamical concepts, and classifies with reliability-aware abstention, achieving competitive accuracy and interpretability without annotations.

pa:2611.05927.name: Modality-Aware Expert Pruning for MoE-Based Multimodal Large Language Models
pa:2611.05927.desc: MAEP is a training-free modality-aware expert pruning framework that decomposes expert importance by modality to compress MoE-based multimodal LLMs, reducing memory while maintaining competitive multimodal and text performance.

pa:2611.14516.desc: TorchCurves is a PyTorch library that enables differentiable, learnable vector-valued parametric curves for integration with neural models and applications such as continuous embeddings, Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, and functional regression.

pa:2611.10866.name: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
pa:2611.10866.desc: How little of a pretrained large language model (LLM) has to change for it to acquire new capabilities? We find that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of its weights, with no other modification, matches full fine-tuning (FFT) at scale across three LLM post-training regimes: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. pa:2611.10015.name: Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering
pa:2611.10015.desc: Micius-Flash is a 27B-parameter multimodal reasoning model trained with a knowledge-tree data pipeline and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, achieving strong hardware and semiconductor agent benchmark results and supporting tool-integrated engineering workflows.

pa:2611.10649.name: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
pa:2611.10649.desc: MACaQ is an MXFP4 W4A4 post-training quantization method that quantizes each linear layer independently using online activation transforms and Hessian-aware refinement, reducing cost while preserving accuracy across language and diffusion models.

pa:2611.12184.name: Blind Variation, Selective Retention: Improving Creative Idea Generation in AI Scientists
pa:2611.12184.desc: Scientific discovery requires ideas that are original, useful, and non-obvious. pa:2611.14116.desc: Visual similarity measured by a self-supervised visual encoder partially explains word generalization in adults and artificial learners, while the composition of teaching examples contributes additional structure beyond that distance.

pa:2611.13425.desc: P2Echo is a unified view-aware text-prompted segmentation framework that uses dynamic image-text alignment to segment diverse cardiac structures across multiple echocardiographic views with high accuracy and low computational cost.

pa:2611.10486.desc: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text through iterative denoising, where decisions about which tokens to commit or remask strongly affect output quality. pa:2611.12177.desc: Early successes on agentic robotics point to a potential paradigm shift toward using coding agents to control robots. pa:2611.14115.name: LEASH: Stay Safe in Agentic Robotics
pa:2611.14115.desc: Foundation models such as GPT and Claude have shown strong capabilities in spatial understanding and embodied intelligence. pa:2611.13576.name: PhyRubric: Rubric-Grounded Diagnostic Evaluation of Physical Commonsense in Text-to-Video Generation
pa:2611.13576.desc: A rubric-based diagnostic benchmark and judge assess physical commonsense in text-to-video generation, showing that current models still struggle and that the judge aligns closely with human judgments.

pa:2610.40754.name: DyCraft: An Agentic System for Long-Horizon 4D Scene Generation
pa:2610.40754.desc: DyCraft improves long-horizon 3D animation by decomposing it into planned static scenes, keyframe storyboards, and local motion authoring to reduce physical errors.

pa:2611.13001.desc: A large aligned benchmark reveals that tabular generation, imputation, and prediction share useful conditional information but show distinct fidelity rankings and objective interactions, motivating unified models that improve categorical reconstruction and joint sampling.

pa:2611.13758.desc: Weight-space programming allows language models to read a trained neural network's weights and edit them. pa:2608.22237.desc: Web-facing AI agents repeatedly access webpages, documents, repositories, and tool responses, yet reading interfaces often expose entire objects when only sparse evidence is needed. pa:2610.40394.desc: A large-scale corpus of structured proof-supervision records derived from university mathematics textbooks improves language model mathematical reasoning by 16.7 percentage points over a base model when used for fine-tuning.

pa:2611.10193.name: Ensemble Routing for Prompt-Adaptive Cost-Aware LLM Inference
pa:2611.10193.desc: PISA and PISA-E use prompt-adaptive capability estimation to route prompts or select cost-aware ensembles, improving cost-performance trade-offs across LLM routing benchmarks.

pa:2610.39671.desc: Large language models (LLMs) draw on parametric knowledge and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to solve knowledge-intensive tasks. pa:2611.13028.desc: AAA games offer a rich testbed for evaluating agent perception, reasoning, and control. pa:2611.12304.desc: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. pa:2611.05862.desc: Large language model (LLM) shopping assistants now recommend products in multi-turn conversations. pa:2611.12869.desc: Cross-modal representational alignment between unimodal language and vision models increases with model capability when captions are clean and informative, but remains below same-modality alignment and can exceed explicitly aligned vision-language models.

pa:2611.14418.desc: A dynamic weight precision allocation strategy is proposed, utilizing low-bit quantization and uncertainty-based gating to selectively upgrade weight precision during LLM generation, thereby optimizing computational cost.

pa:2611.11306.desc: AI agents deployed on the open web are becoming more capable of performing actions that may breach contractual provisions and violate computer security laws. pa:2611.08538.desc: Subliminal learning can transfer hidden preferences from teacher to student vision-language models through unrelated visual tasks, affecting image choices and explanations.

pa:2611.11531.desc: Jointly selecting layers and modules in transformer foundation models yields better probing features than depth-only or final-layer approaches, and simple fixed strategies recover much of the gain.

pa:2611.08318.name: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
pa:2611.08318.desc: Exposing benchmark success criteria to self-improving embodied coding agents can raise measured success under those criteria without improving instructed-task completion, and the advantage weakens under slight criteria changes and transfers poorly across tasks, while instruction-faithful criteria better reflect instructed-task performance.

pa:2607.13920.name: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
pa:2607.13920.desc: A dynamic stress-testing framework shows that search agents often answer confidently despite unreliable retrieved evidence and may rely on memorized knowledge when documents are factually wrong.

pa:2611.14046.name: Structured Confidence Perturbation via Fisher Geometry for Adversarial Training
pa:2611.14046.desc: A hybrid adversarial training approach combining cross-entropy and KL divergence with geometry-aware perturbations on the confidence manifold improves robustness and transferability by targeting confidence structure deformation.

pa:2611.12872.name: HiVe-Mem: Interleaving Horizontal Memory Expansion and Vertical Evidence Composition for Multimodal Agents
pa:2611.12872.desc: A novel multimodal memory framework enhances long-term interaction by combining relational graph expansion of semantic seeds with query-adaptive composition of heterogeneous evidence forms.

pa:2611.17331.name: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
pa:2611.17331.desc: By baking global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, Test-Time Baking (TTB) enhances the fidelity of novel-view decoding in Large View Synthesis Models while maintaining the efficiency of Test-Time Training.

pa:2611.08219.name: Agent-R^2: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis
pa:2611.08219.desc: A real-source data synthesis framework trains a 4B agent on 4k task instances with supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving realistic productivity work and file-grounded reasoning over larger models.

pa:2611.17060.name: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
pa:2611.17060.desc: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. pa:2610.41453.name: Evidence-Guided Recovery for AI Agents with Ambiguous Tool Outcomes and Partial Execution
pa:2610.41453.desc: Tool timeouts can leave AI agents facing ambiguous tool outcomes and partial execution: an action may have failed, committed or remained in flight while other workflow steps have already completed. We formulate evidence-guided task recovery over approved obligations, provider capabilities and states compatible with public evidence. pa:2611.00428.name: Do Multimodal Models Decide Consistently on Equivalent Optical Spectra?
pa:2611.00428.desc: A spectrum can be given to a model as a table in nanometers or as a plot in photon energy, and the decision should not depend on which one it sees. When the data needed for an answer are missing, the model should say so. pa:2611.17167.name: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
pa:2611.17167.desc: A decision model that acts poorly can still teach reinforcement learning policies effectively by judging complete action trajectories, improving success on ALFWorld and WebShop.

pa:2611.00359.name: Humanized but Still True? Auditing Facts and Detection in AI-Text Humanizers
pa:2611.00359.desc: AI "humanizers" rewrite machine-generated text so that detectors classify it as human-written. Public leaderboards score evasion and embedding similarity, but not whether checkable details survive. pa:2611.16905.name: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
pa:2611.16905.desc: FOAM is a lightweight SOAP variant that uses input-only preconditioning and a factored Adam-moment estimator to match strong second-order and Muon baselines in LLM pre-training while using half the optimizer state and running at Muon-class speed.

pa:2611.15777.name: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
pa:2611.15777.desc: SO-Arena evaluates System One models across domains and capability families, revealing that scaling and reasoning gains vary and that high overall accuracy does not ensure reliable decision-making.

pa:2611.16217.name: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
pa:2611.16217.desc: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it? pa:2611.16517.name: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
pa:2611.16517.desc: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. pa:2611.16748.name: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
pa:2611.16748.desc: PhysLoop leverages large language models to guide video generation, selection, and correction, enabling physically consistent self-improvement and controllable data construction for video models.

pa:2611.16321.name: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
pa:2611.16321.desc: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. pa:2611.15131.desc: A reciprocal world model enables real-time full-duplex audiovisual interaction by jointly modeling intent and realization using autoregressive reasoning, synchronized attention, and dual rollout distillation.

pa:2611.13004.name: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
pa:2611.13004.desc: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. pa:2611.05984.desc: A systematic study of Hyper-Connections architectures identifies the simpler efficient design SimpleHC, which removes residual mixing and uses shared memory access to match mHC performance while adding minimal training overhead and improving stability.

pa:2611.16409.name: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
pa:2611.16409.desc: Language-model agents trained with reinforcement learning can improve by learning to create and curate experience artifacts that help future rollouts, not just by optimizing actions from scalar rewards.

pa:2611.16009.name: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
pa:2611.16009.desc: A simplified evaluation harness that keeps full episode history and stops motions early substantially improves robot-use agent scores on RoboDojo, with scene geometry providing the largest additional benefit.

pa:2611.15844.name: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
pa:2611.15844.desc: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. pa:2611.14256.desc: A survey analyzes why self-improvement mechanisms for multimodal agents transfer unevenly across reasoning, generation, navigation, and manipulation scenarios, framing them as trade-offs over scarce factors and task-structural resources.

pa:2611.12750.name: The Narrative Gap: Can LLMs Help Us Navigate Diverse Narratives Across Languages?
pa:2611.12750.desc: A benchmark of news articles and queries shows that current large language models cannot reliably help users navigate diverse multilingual narratives, leaving gaps in exposure to competing accounts and risking echo chambers and information disparities.

pa:2611.15094.name: A frontier machine intelligence for human neuroimaging
pa:2611.15094.desc: A vision-language model trained on nearly one million clinical neuroimaging studies interprets complete examinations, discusses findings in natural language, and outperforms existing general and medical models in diagnosis, localization, reporting, and progression assessment.

pa:2611.17334.name: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
pa:2611.17334.desc: Controlled experiments show that multimodal language models do not need a pretrained vision encoder, but benefit from dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and integrated early rather than before fusion.

pa:2611.16728.name: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
pa:2611.16728.desc: EgoX is an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that pretrains a modular Transformer with embodiment dreaming on heterogeneous human, robot, and simulated demonstrations, then fine-tunes it to improve manipulation task progress, especially under out-of-distribution conditions.

pa:2611.17336.desc: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time.
